command:
set +e
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
{ uname -m; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; grep -o -m1 -w avx512f /proc/cpuinfo || echo 'no avx512f'
  Rscript -e 'cat("preprocessCore", as.character(packageVersion("preprocessCore")), "\n"); x <- matrix(runif(4e5), ncol = 4); y <- preprocessCore::normalize.quantiles(x); cat("normalize.quantiles ok", dim(y), "\n")' 2>&1
  echo "Rscript exit $?"; } > /tmp/out/probe.txt 2>&1
cat /tmp/out/probe.txt
